messages:
Maria (PM): Quick sync — need decision on streaming transport for chat/completions. Customer asks: SSE feels easier for proxies but mobile apps prefer WS. Can we pick one for GA?
Kevin (Eng): short answer: both, but we need a minimal contract. prefer to support SSE first + WS later. SSE faster to ship.
Anil (Infra): SSE has easier LB/backpressure story for our edge infra. WS needs sticky routing and more state. Also cost diff on NLB keepalives.
Tasha (DevEx): Mobile SDKs already exposing ws with reconnect TTL. But server resume semantics are messy over WS. SSE gives native resume via reconnection + last-event-id.
Oliver (Sales): Major customer (FinX) requires resume + deterministic finish reasons for audit. They prefer WS if we can guarantee replay/resume semantics.
Priya (SRE): SLA note: persistent WS connections increase file descriptors and flakiness during deploys. Need rollout plan if we go WS GA.
Kevin (Eng): Proposal: GA: SSE delta stream with compact event envelope; v1 WS proxy mode (reverse-proxy to SSE) + roadmap to native WS with multiplexing.
Maria (PM): What should delta envelope look like? customers want structured tokens + function-call deltas + finish_reason explicit.
Kevin (Eng): Draft envelope: ```event: delta
data: {"type":"token","token":"hello","role":"assistant"}
```
Then ```event: func
data: {"type":"call","name":"search","args":{"q":"x"}}
```
Finish events: ```event: done
data: {"finish_reason":"stop"}
```
Anil (Infra): Agree include finish_reason enum: stop, length, timeout, error, fallback. We need clear semantics when multiple partials arrive.
Tasha (DevEx): SDKs should expose incremental JSON patch style for structured output and function call assembly. Also expose onFinish with reason and latency metrics.
Oliver (Sales): Add launch gate: GA only if we support deterministic finish_reason mapping and a resume strategy for <30s disconnect for FinX. They will push.
Priya (SRE): Operational gate: observable metrics for dropped events, reconnect rate, and 99th token latency must be under 250ms on hosted tier. Without those we can't GA.
Maria (PM): Customer-driven gates summarized: FinX resume requirement + deterministic finish_reason. Internal gates: infra SRE metrics + SDK parity. Timeline: aim for beta in 6 weeks, GA in 12 if no major blockers.
Kevin (Eng): Risks: WS native adds ~3 weeks infra work. SSE-first reduces risk. We'll prototype WS+proxy to validate mobile.
Maria (PM): Action items: @Kevin produce SSE+delta spec by EOD Friday; @Tasha draft SDK delta API for iOS/android; @Anil run LB cost estimate; @Oliver confirm FinX acceptance criteria.
Kevin (Eng): ack. I'll push spec draft to the repo and ping here.
deploy-bot: Kevin pushed branch feature/streaming-deltas to github.com/redwood/rt/compare
Oliver (Sales): FinX confirms resume within 30s + finish_reason required. They can start beta if SSE meets those semantics.
Maria (PM): Ok let's lock SSE-first + proxy WS plan. We'll track WS native as next quarter.
Priya (SRE): I'll add SLO checks to the onboarding dashboard and a canary plan for connection churn.
Tasha (DevEx): I'll prepare migration guide for customers using short-polling to adopt streaming.
Maria (PM): Thanks everyone. We'll reconvene next Wed for spec review.
